  • Method Details

    • add

      public boolean add(ClientHandler handler)
      Attempts to add a new client to the lobby. If the lobby has reached its capacity (6 clients), the client is rejected with an error message.
      Parameters:
      handler - The client handler to add.
      Returns:
      true if the client was added; false if the lobby is full.

    • remove

      public void remove(ClientHandler handler)
      Removes a client from the lobby.
      Parameters:
      handler - The client handler to remove.

    • size

      public int size()
      Returns the number of clients currently in the lobby.
      Returns:
      The number of connected clients.

    • allReady

      public boolean allReady()
      Checks whether all clients are ready. A client is considered ready if their associated player exists and is marked as ready.
      Returns:
      true if all clients are ready; false otherwise.

    • allAreAi

      public boolean allAreAi(ConcurrentMap<ClientHandler, Boolean> isAI)
      Determines whether all connected clients are AI-controlled.
      Parameters:
      isAI - A concurrent map associating clients with their AI status.
      Returns:
      true if all clients are AI; false otherwise.

    • getClients

      public List<ClientHandler> getClients()
      Returns a copy of the current client list.
      Returns:
      A new list containing all clients in the lobby.
